purpose: Machine-verifiable metadata intake for exact-edition rights and terms review; this artifact records limits and unknowns and does not clear any source for redistribution.

method.scope: six exact editions already registered in data/seed/source_edition_template.csv
checks: manifest bytes and declared content SHA-256 were recorded
canonical publication locator and any recorded terms locator were captured
current repository rights and redistribution statuses were copied without promotion
no source bytes, excerpts, contacts or legal conclusions were added
method.claim_limit: A public locator or owner assumption is not rights clearance. Exact-edition licence, database-right, third-party-component and redistribution conditions remain separately reviewable.

editions.disposition: acquisition-time manifest recorded an OGL notice, but the current controlled-source disposition remains review_required and metadata-only
editions.required_action: reconcile the exact edition licence notice, database-right conditions and third-party exclusions before any reuse decision

editions.disposition: official edition identified; no exact-edition reuse terms were established by this intake
